text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... Heheh. My time improved again, 
didn't it?♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, you seem in good shape today too. Did 
you stumble upon a good training method or 
something?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Its name is the "Vodka-san 
Training"!!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I'll tuck a photo of Vodka-san into my 
pocket while I train♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san is always watching over me. Just 
thinking about that fills my entire body 
with mana!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I face hardship, gazing at this 
photo gives me the courage to overcome 
it...!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I can push myself without limit, all to be 
someone Vodka-san can be proud of♪

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...H-Huh~. Her photo actually has that 
kind of effect?

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text: Yes! It worked like an absolute charm!

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
I am deeply grateful to Trainer for 
suggesting this training methodâª

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, should I go snap a photo of her 
sometime? Assuming she's okay with it, of 
course."

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Vodka-san always seems so full of life 
when she's with Scarlet-san, it's lovely♪

text_block_list.name: Red Desire
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that will surely give you plenty of 
vitality!
